note: Graveborn Hollow King (unit identity, Graveborn Legendary): the grandest of the six, tall and broad (body 10x14x5, arms 4x13x4, legs 5x14x5): black grave-iron plate split open over a lit soul-fire ribcage, a broken funeral-gilt crown with a violet stone, a bare skull with its jaw bound in gilt wire and soul-lit eyes, layered pauldrons with broken spikes, a high gorget, a violet-hemmed rag skirt, slit greaves over bare bone and one large tattered team-cloth cloak dragging behind. Carries the grave sword. Tier I only; no flag. Glow sheet 16 texels (ribs and eyes).
